# Forward-chaining verifier for the BoardgameQA-style vampire/crow question.
# Standard library only. Computes the status from the stated facts and rules.

PRIMARY_COLORS = {"red", "green", "blue"}  # source-domain convention


def build_facts():
    facts = set()
    covid_start_year = 2020
    movie_year = 1999
    if movie_year < covid_start_year:           # real arithmetic on the release year
        facts.add(("watches_pre_covid_movie", "goat"))
    facts.add(("disarms", "mule", "dachshund"))
    facts.add(("card_color", "stork", "red"))
    facts.add(("hates", "stork", "Chris Ronaldo"))
    facts.add(("not_shouts", "beetle", "reindeer"))
    facts.add(("not_disarms", "dugong", "beaver"))
    facts.add(("low_income", "goat"))           # high-salary rule (Rule11) does not fire
    return facts


def step(facts):
    """One round of rule application. Returns (new_positive, new_negative) conclusions."""
    pos, neg = set(), set()
    animals = {f[1] for f in facts if f[0] in ("disarms", "not_disarms", "not_shouts")}
    animals |= {"goat", "stork", "dugong", "beetle", "mule"}

    # Rule1: goat watches pre-covid movie -> goat shouts at coyote
    if ("watches_pre_covid_movie", "goat") in facts:
        pos.add(("shouts_coyote", "goat"))

    # Rule2: someone shouts at coyote -> snake unites with vampire
    if any(f[0] == "shouts_coyote" for f in facts | pos):
        pos.add(("unites", "snake", "vampire"))

    # Rule3 / Rule8: stork has primary-colored card or is a Chris Ronaldo fan -> falls on ostrich
    if any(f[0] == "card_color" and f[1] == "stork" and f[2] in PRIMARY_COLORS for f in facts) \
            or ("hates", "stork", "Chris Ronaldo") in facts:
        pos.add(("falls_ostrich", "stork"))

    # Rule4: evidence that someone disarms the zebra -> stork does not tear down vampire's castle
    rule4_fires = any(f[0] == "disarms" and f[2] == "zebra" for f in facts)
    if rule4_fires:
        neg.add(("tears_castle", "stork"))

    # Rule12: falls on ostrich -> tears down vampire's castle (blocked if Rule4 fires, Rule4 preferred)
    for f in facts | pos:
        if f[0] == "falls_ostrich" and not ("tears_castle", f[1]) in neg:
            pos.add(("tears_castle", f[1]))

    # Rule5: disarms dachshund -> borrows vampire weapon (Rule10 preferred; Rule10 needs
    # "creates a castle for the swan", which is absent, so it does not block)
    for f in facts:
        if f[0] == "disarms" and f[2] == "dachshund":
            pos.add(("borrows_vampire", f[1]))

    # Rule9: mule borrows vampire weapon -> vampire destroys camel's wall
    if ("borrows_vampire", "mule") in facts | pos:
        pos.add(("destroys_wall", "vampire"))

    # Rule7: some animal does not disarm beaver -> smiles at vampire
    for f in facts:
        if f[0] == "not_disarms" and f[2] == "beaver":
            pos.add(("smiles_vampire", f[1]))

    # Rule14: stork tears down vampire's castle AND snake unites with vampire
    #         -> vampire never swims in pool next to crow
    if ("tears_castle", "stork") in facts | pos and ("unites", "snake", "vampire") in facts | pos:
        pos.add(("never_swims", "vampire", "crow"))

    return pos, neg


def forward_chain(facts):
    facts = set(facts)
    negatives = set()
    while True:
        pos, neg = step(facts)
        new_facts = facts | pos
        new_neg = negatives | neg
        if new_facts == facts and new_neg == negatives:
            break
        facts, negatives = new_facts, new_neg
    return facts, negatives


facts0 = build_facts()
derived, negatives = forward_chain(facts0)

stork_tears = ("tears_castle", "stork") in derived and ("tears_castle", "stork") not in negatives
snake_unites = ("unites", "snake", "vampire") in derived
never_swims = ("never_swims", "vampire", "crow") in derived
rule4_active = any(f[0] == "disarms" and f[2] == "zebra" for f in derived)

print("stork tears down vampire's castle:", stork_tears)
print("snake unites with vampire:", snake_unites)
print("Rule4 (zebra disarm evidence) active:", rule4_active)
print("vampire never swims next to crow derived:", never_swims)

if never_swims and not ("never_swims", "vampire", "crow") in negatives:
    status = "proved"
elif ("never_swims", "vampire", "crow") in negatives:
    status = "disproved"
else:
    status = "unknown"

print("derived status:", status)

submitted = "proved"
if status == submitted:
    print("CHECK PASS")
else:
    print("CHECK FAIL")
